Alex L: Quick ask — we need approval to lock reserved H100 capacity in ap-northeast-1 for Q3. Proposal: 48 H100 equivalents, 12-month term. This covers Dedicated burst demand + planned evals.
Maria S: Can you drop the utilization forecast and straight-up $ impact?
Alex L: Sure — forecasted steady-state utilization ~75%, daily peak windows (2h) up to ~95% for eval runs. Current mix: 60% hosted, 40% Dedicated bursts. On-demand est cost ~ $14/hr/GPU. 12m reserved effective ~ $7.50/hr/GPU. 36m reserved ~ $6.20/hr/GPU.
Devon R: Why APAC (ap-northeast-1) specifically? Any network/region constraints pushing this?
Alex L: Primary reasons: (1) Low-latency for JP/KR pilot customers, (2) regulatory preference for local capacity, (3) our current us-west pool is hitting thermal limits during nightly retrains. Cross-region replication adds egress cost and latency for these customers.
Harper (finops): Numbers please — monthly cashflow and realized saving vs on-demand. Also need cost center and PO flow.
Alex L: Short scenario below. Numbers approximate, all USD.
```
Scenario for 48 H100 (12m) - 730 hours/mo
On-demand: 48 * 14 * 730 = $490,560/mo
Reserved (12m @ $7.50/hr): 48 * 7.5 * 730 = $262,800/mo
Savings vs on-demand: $227,760/mo (~46%)
Reserved (36m @ $6.20/hr): 48 * 6.2 * 730 = $217,420/mo (~56% vs on-demand)
Estimated commit invoice cadence: monthly (prepaid amortized) or upfront depending on vendor.
```
Maria S: Those savings look great but what if utilization drops to 50%? Risk analysis?
Alex L: At 50% utiliz, effective cost rises but still below on-demand for 12m: 262.8k * (0.5/0.75) ≈ 175.2k effective usage cost vs 245.28k on-demand equivalent at 50% (48 * 14 * 365/12 * 0.5) — still net positive. Main risk is multi-month underutil leading to cashflow pressure.
Devon R: Can we split — smaller guaranteed commit + burst credits? Any vendor flexibility?
Alex L: Vendor offered layered plan: base commit + 20% burst capacity at on-demand rates maybe discounted 10%. Also we can choose a regional split (24 APAC + 24 USW) but APAC savings are highest due to regional pricing.
sre-bot: Incident note: capacity-request doc updated -> https://internal.redwood/infra/capacity/1912345678 (automated) :gear: 
Harper (finops): Provide the formal ask for PO: cost center, legal entity, expected start date, invoice term. Also include a short ROI note for the exec PO.
Alex L: Cost center: ENG-INFRA-APAC. Start target: 2026-05-01. Invoice term: monthly amortized preferred; vendor requires 12m credit commit. ROI note: ~46% per-month token cost reduction vs on-demand for baseline workload; payback within 2 months if we hit forecasted utilization on top of existing usage.
Harper (finops): Provisional ok from finance assuming you attach utilization dashboard + projected customer bookings that justify the APAC capacity. Need final approval from Product head and Legal for contract T&Cs. Please prepare PO request doc and tag me.
Maria S: I'll assemble the utilization graphs (last 90 days) and the Q3 bookings slip.
Devon R: Also confirm fallback plan: can we reassign some of the reserved to batch jobs or internal research if customer demand is lower?
Alex L: Yes — we will prioritize Dedicated bursts -> internal training -> batch experiments. We'll add autoscaler knob to cap Dedicated traffic if we need to smooth costs.
Harper (finops): OK — tag me when PO doc is ready. If legal finds any early-termination clauses that are risky, we will re-evaluate term length. :eyes:
Alex L: Thanks — I'll prep the PO + contract summary and ping you all. Quick CLI to create the provisional reserve in our planning tool for docs: 
```
redwoodctl reserve create --region ap-northeast-1 --gpu h100 --count 48 --term 12m --notes "Q3 APAC evals + Dedicated burst"
```
Maria S: :thumbsup: I'll help with the attachment.
Harper (finops): Approve provisional ask pending PO/doc. Please include ledger string in PR.
Alex L: Will do — cc: ENG-INFRA-APAC on the PR. Thanks everyone.
